content: Reference DCB demos: AxonIQ/university-demo (course capacity + per-student course cap; vertical slices write/read/automation; in-memory store or Axon Server; GWT tests via AxonTestFixture; SubscribeStudentToCourse criteria = OR of courseId reads and studentId reads). maxzillabong/axon-5-dcb-demo (money transfer, 4.x saga vs DCB LOC contrast).
